info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Certification Update API
info.description: The Employee Certification Update API allows businesses to efficiently manage and update employee certification records within their human resource management systems. Through this endpoint, HR representatives can modify existing certification details for employees, ensuring that records are up-to-date and comply with organizational standards. This API is particularly valuable for companies that need to track certification status for compliance, skills validation, or professional development. Typical consumers of this API include HR personnel and systems integrators who manage employee training and certification processes.
